event.label: alleged
event.text: Union Minister Jitendra Singh alleged at a press conference in Bengaluru on November 5 that CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke received money from US-based donors and co-founder Ashutosh Ranka from Pakistani politicians, saying there was enough evidence. The CJP questioned the credibility of officials making the claim, and Congress leader Priyank Kharge asked the government to produce proof, Outlook India, India Today and News18 reported.
